idea.Name: a2_prasc_validation_replication_sensitivity
idea.Title: Replication, Ablation, and Sensitivity Audit for A2 Rank, Bias, and Acquisition Controls
idea.Short Hypothesis: The existing a2val E1/E2/E3/E5 and optional physical-tangent package can be turned into a substantive quantitative report only if the preregistered checks are actually re-run under a fixed seed matrix and then extended with first-class baseline ablations, negative controls, and threshold sweeps. This revision tests whether the conditional rank, bias, and acquisition controls remain non-vacuous under independent re-execution and sensitivity analysis; it does not introduce a new algorithm, model, or hardware claim.
idea.Related Work: Projections, Schur complements, SOM/TSOM, coherent calibration, variable projection, source extension, continuation, and experiment design remain prior machinery. The implementation already produced an a2val package with run scripts, assertion tests, JSON/CSV results, and figures. This revision is a direct follow-up to the completed analysis-only audit: it keeps the same package and protocol but replaces artifact parsing with actual re-execution, ablation scripts, and sensitivity runs.
idea.Abstract: We revise the A2 validation work package from a post-hoc summary audit into an executed replication and sensitivity study. The implemented E1/E2/E3/E5 modules and the optional shared physical-core tangent run are re-run under a fixed seed matrix, recording Monte Carlo sample sizes, runtimes, and raw JSON/CSV artifacts. New runner and sweep scripts execute the four planned baseline comparisons as controlled ablations: physical versus free-current envelope, relative-only versus absolute and bias-aware gates, shared-map versus independent-map profiling, and greedy versus pair lookahead. Negative controls and threshold sweeps over noise level, rank threshold, and gate threshold are generated from existing modules to classify false-positive modes and boundary sensitivity. The study reports seed-level 95% CIs, replication pass/fail, ablation deltas, and explicit positive/negative/indeterminate conclusions. Claims remain limited to synthetic conditional controls; E4, nonlinear superiority, SOM exclusivity, publication acceptance, and universal basin behavior are not claimed unless a corresponding runner is available and executed.

datasets: Existing A2 E1 scalar matched complex/intensity exact examples, re-run under the fixed seed matrix
Existing A2 E2/E3/E5 exact and random fixed-tangent examples, re-run under the fixed seed matrix
Synthetic noise-level sweeps for E2/E3/E5 using existing modules
Optional physical tangents from the separately implemented shared core, interpreted only as secondary corroboration
Negative-control outputs and threshold-sweep outputs generated from existing a2val modules
baselines: relative-only versus absolute and bias-aware gates
limited-aperture tangent and nearly-parallel-range controls if supported by the existing modules, otherwise recorded as not run
metrics: backward-error-scaled identity residual mean, standard deviation, and 95% confidence interval across fixed-seed reruns
Fisher contraction ratio with Monte Carlo confidence intervals
covariance and bias risk ratios versus absolute and relative gates
acquisition innovation gain, submodularity violation count, and greedy-versus-lookahead delta
threshold-sweep pass boundaries, false-positive rate, and rank/noise sensitivity tables
replication pass/fail, runtime, and recorded Monte Carlo sample size per runner
Experiments.compute_estimate: Small CPU-only NumPy/SciPy using the existing venv and scripts. Add a fixed-seed matrix runner, ablation scripts for the four baselines, and sweep/negative-control scripts. No GPU, no installation, no new large-scale data; expected runtime is modest because it re-executes the existing small synthetic package.
steps: Read TASK.md, inventory all existing scripts and parameters, and confirm which seeds, noise levels, rank thresholds, and gate thresholds can be set from the command line or config
Add a fixed-seed matrix runner that actually executes E1, E2, E3, E5, and the optional physical tangent, recording seed count, Monte Carlo sample size, runtime, and raw JSON/CSV outputs
Recompute all evidence metrics from the newly generated artifacts, not from previous summary CSVs; report seed-level 95% Student-t CIs and replication pass/fail
Execute the four planned baseline comparisons as separate ablation scripts that write raw JSON/CSV and compact tables
Run negative controls and threshold sweeps using existing modules; classify false-positive modes and determine where rank, noise, and gate thresholds change the conclusions
Attempt limited-aperture tangent and nearly-parallel-range controls if the existing parameterization supports them; otherwise write an explicit not-run ledger with reasons
Write a revised quantitative supplement with replication, ablation, sensitivity, and interpretation sections; preserve all discrepancies, counterexamples, and unsupported claims

Risk Factors and Limitations: The existing package may not support every desired sweep or control, especially limited-aperture tangents and physical 8-candidate acquisition-policy comparison; missing items will be recorded rather than inferred from old artifacts
The synthetic validation package may still be underpowered for a full ACL Rolling Review paper even after re-execution and sensitivity analysis
Exact identities and near-zero residuals can be vacuous sanity checks if negative controls are not carefully interpreted; the threshold and negative-control sweeps are intended to bound this risk
The optional physical-tangent run remains secondary corroboration and may be too weak for strong physical claims
Seed sensitivity or failed replication on some sweeps may emerge and should be reported honestly rather than hidden
No claim is made about E4 primary comparison, nonlinear superiority, SOM exclusivity, universal basin behavior, or publication acceptance

report.summary: The round ended without a researcher summary. The working directory contains an existing a2val implementation package, prior E1/E2/E3/E5 and optional physical-tangent run scripts, result JSON/CSV artifacts, figures, tests, and an environment report. The environment report confirms the specified venv works with Python 3.13.13, numpy 2.5.2, scipy 1.18.1, and matplotlib 3.11.1. However, the provided evidence does not include contents documenting a newly added fixed-seed matrix runner, the four planned baseline ablation scripts, or negative-control/threshold sweep outputs. Therefore the specific replication/ablation/sensitivity conclusions proposed in the IDEA cannot yet be substantiated from this round's evidence.
key_results: Environment validation completed: Python 3.13.13, numpy 2.5.2, scipy 1.18.1, matplotlib 3.11.1; scipy.special.i0/i1 and scipy.stats.ncx2 are available.
Existing a2val package modules are present: e1.py (23948 bytes), e2.py (33965 bytes), e3.py (38490 bytes), e5.py (43218 bytes), physical_runner.py (20095 bytes).
Prior run scripts and artifacts exist for E1/E2/E3/E5, plus optional physical runs, including results/*_results.json, results/*_summary.csv, figures/*.png, and results/A2_quantitative_supplement.md.
No evidence was found in the supplied file contents of a fixed-seed matrix runner, the four ablation comparisons, or negative-control/threshold-sweep runs required by the IDEA.
No quantitative CI, replication pass/fail, ablation delta, or sensitivity table can be reported from this round because the relevant new artifacts were not substantiated in the available evidence.
completed_steps: Environment/site validation was completed and recorded in env_report.txt.
The existing a2val package, run scripts, result artifacts, figures, and tests are present in the working directory.
Prior E1/E2/E3/E5 and optional physical-tangent result files are available for inspection.

unresolved_issues: No fixed-seed matrix runner was implemented or executed in this round: there are no new raw JSON/CSV artifacts from actual reruns of E1/E2/E3/E5 and the optional physical-tangent run, so seed-level CIs and replication pass/fail cannot be reported.

The four planned baseline ablations are absent: physical vs free-current envelope, relative-only vs absolute/bias-aware gates, shared-map vs independent-map profiling, and greedy vs pair lookahead were not run, so no ablation deltas are available.
Negative controls and threshold sweeps over noise level, rank threshold, and gate threshold were not executed, leaving boundary sensitivity and false-positive modes unmeasured.
The report gives no Monte Carlo sample sizes, runtimes, or seed counts for the proposed reruns, so the reliability and computational cost of the central claims are unsubstantiated.
The study currently relies only on prior summary artifacts and environment validation; it lacks newly generated robustness checks and discrepancy reporting needed for a full ACL Rolling Review paper.
If limited-aperture tangent or nearly-parallel-range controls are unsupported, the missing-run ledger was not produced, so readers cannot distinguish unsupported claims from untested ones.
verdict.reasoning: The experiment report shows only that the existing a2val package works under the reported environment. None of the core empirical contributions proposed in the IDEA were executed: no fixed-seed reruns, no ablation scripts, no negative controls, and no threshold sweeps. Therefore the substantive replication, sensitivity, and baseline-comparison conclusions are entirely unsupported in this round. The direction is not shown to be broken, and the existing package provides a plausible basis for the study, so abandonment is unwarranted. However, the work is currently at a pilot or inventory stage, far below the full-paper bar. It needs actual re-execution with multiple seeds, saved raw artifacts, CIs, ablation deltas, sensitivity tables, and honest reporting of any missing or failed controls before it can be locked for write-up.
